units: millions except per-share USD and decimal rates

assumptions.classification: Assumptions, not issuer guidance or observed sustainable cashflows
assumptions.sbc_policy: EBIT includes SBC; no SBC add-back, no second subtraction. Future dilution assumed offset by cash-equivalent SBC cost.
assumptions.lease_policy: Operating leases remain rental operating costs; financing-debt EV convention. Finance-lease debt-only FY25-sized stress quantified; latest principal/cashflow gap not quantified.
assumptions.share_policy: Latest reported quarter weighted-average diluted shares, not verified October fully diluted outstanding count.
assumptions.capex_policy: Full FY25 cash PP&E capex anchor; not maintenance-only. FY25 rounded PPE depreciation8000 is forward assumption, not exact TTM. Other amortization remains expensed in EBIT. Growth investment is max(g/ROIIC*NOPAT, scaled baseline netcapex/WC budget), not sum.
assumptions.working_capital_policy: Remove all observed operating asset/liability cash timing; neutral normalized baseline. Future total reinvestment modeled through ROIIC, includes capex net of D&A and operating WC.

limitations: Tariff uplift estimated from rounded approximately 2 margin points, not exact refund cash collection.
18% tax and neutral WC are normalization assumptions, not statutory or issuer-guided cash tax.
Future ROIIC is an explicit sensitivity assumption, not financing-distorted historical ROIC.
PPE depreciation uses rounded FY25 anchor because exact9M split unavailable; intangible amortization is not added back, but unmatched additional intangible cash investment remains a scenario risk.
No current fully diluted shares or exact October debt fair value; minimum operating cash reserve assumed.
Cashflow and valuation completion does not complete missing peer-rating/document coverage.
